comment: One row per improver stage. kind is upstream's claude_cli channel. A row with a provider talks to that provider's Anthropic-compatible endpoint through the same CLI; the others use this box's own Claude login. max_budget_usd bounds one session as the CLI itself prices it (API-equivalent for Claude; for DeepSeek the CLI prices an unknown model like Claude, about 3.6x the real cost, so the bound is conservative).

deepseek.tested: 2026-11-01: Read/Write/Edit/Glob/Grep tool use, model deepseek-v4-pro and deepseek-v4-pro[1m] (1M-token window), usage reported in tokens; total_cost_usd is NOT DeepSeek's price
